summary: Victory Pay task-payment iteration tested end-to-end. Backend: 32/32 pytest tests PASSED (auth, referrals, tasks list, task-payment flow with screenshot validation, admin approve/reject crediting logic, payout accounts CRUD w/ UPI validation, withdraw w/ account_id, admin approve deducts balance, support chat + admin threads, non-admin 403 on admin endpoints, live stats, wallet UPI info w/ 2 QR images and big_payment_upi='harsh.g216@ptyes', /config telegram link, full e2e ₹1200 task -> +₹1320 -> withdraw ₹500 -> -₹500). Frontend: intro animation plays ~3s on launch, landing renders correctly with landing-login-button/sign-in, login flow works for both admin and user, balance-card loads, Tasks tab shows tab-premium-plans/tab-daily-tasks with 6 reward cards, payment screen renders all required testIDs (payment-qr, upi-id, upload-screenshot-button, declaration-checkbox, payment-submit-button) with correct amount (₹1,200 -> receive ₹1,520 shown) and dual-QR image, Admin panel exposes all 4 tabs (payments/withdrawals/support/users), Accounts and Help screens reachable. No red screens, no runtime errors. Minor: React Native web deprecation warning `props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents` from AnimatedIntro/Toast/payment pulseRing.

react_native_issues.issue: Deprecation warning: 'props.pointerEvents is deprecated. Use style.pointerEvents'. Move pointerEvents from JSX prop to style object. Reference: /app/frontend/src/components/AnimatedIntro.tsx:54, /app/frontend/src/components/Toast.tsx:39, /app/frontend/app/payment/[taskId].tsx:127

action_items: Migrate `pointerEvents` prop to `style={{pointerEvents:'none'}}` in AnimatedIntro.tsx, Toast.tsx, payment/[taskId].tsx to remove React Native web deprecation warning.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py at ~640 lines is nearing the recommended 700 LOC split point; consider splitting routes into modules (auth/admin/wallet/tasks/support) soon.
task_payments screenshots are stored inline as base64 in Mongo docs which can bloat documents; consider GridFS or S3 for future.
admin_payment_action returns HTTP 400 for already-processed payments even if the client is polling — acceptable but ensure client handles gracefully.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all critical screens & testIDs render correctly, flows navigable)

seed_data_creation: No persistent seed data required beyond backend auto-seeded tasks & admin. Tests create ephemeral users prefixed with test_.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend regression suite lives at /app/backend/tests/test_victory_pay.py (pytest-xdist loadscope, uses shared class state). BASE_URL comes from EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL. Admin creds admin@victorypay.com / Admin@123. Payment screenshot must be >50 chars else 400. UI intro animation plays on every hard reload (page.goto) — for in-app nav tests, prefer clicking links instead of goto to avoid replaying the intro.
rca_of_issue: N/A — no blocking or functional issues found. Only a cosmetic React Native web deprecation warning for `pointerEvents` prop usage.
